_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 12:23 ET AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled and no good-faith violation is reachable - unchanged from the 10:23 and 11:23 reads because nothing has traded. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live at 12:23 and BOTH ARE EMPTY, so no exit of any kind is due: no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window exists to be reached this hour. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-19, so agentTrades stays 0 and the 33.87 level remains unowned. THE FINDING OF THIS HOUR IS THE OPPOSITE OF LAST HOUR'S AND IT IS RECORDED AS SUCH: the limit that was touched on seven bars between 09:50 and 10:50 was NOT REACHABLE AT ANY POINT IN THIS ONE. The lowest five-minute low between 11:20 and 12:15 ET is 34.08, which is 0.21 ABOVE the 33.87 limit, so the window in which a resting order would have filled closed roughly ninety minutes ago and has not reopened. The specification is RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED for a third consecutive hour: AS is 34.23 bid / 34.26 ask at 16:23:26.523Z on a 0.088% spread, last trade 34.23, +1.81% on the bid against the 33.62 close, leaving 33.87 sitting 0.36 below the bid as a resting buy. THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED, and the drift is now the whole argument for raising it - which is precisely why it is refused for a seventh time. Both written invalidations are untouched: the 33.70 early warning is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening five minutes and not revisited in six and a half hours of tape, and the 33.41 outright void is 0.82 below the bid and untestable before the bell. Its 372.57 cost is 36.9% of the account, inside the 40% single-name ceiling, and it is the only claim on the cash. Fired 12:22 against the 12:17 slot, five minutes late and fifteen minutes inside the 20-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 16:23:26.523Z against a local 12:23 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - the 100% EPS beat of 8/18, whose gap faded and whose close held, specified today at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 12:23 AND CONFIRMED FOR A THIRD HOUR - AND THE LEVEL THAT WAS REACHABLE ALL OF LAST HOUR WAS OUT OF REACH FOR ALL OF THIS ONE. AS is 34.23 bid / 34.26 ask at 16:23:26.523Z on a 0.088% spread, last trade 34.23, +1.81% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close. THE 33.87 LIMIT IS UNFILLED AND NOW SITS 0.36 BELOW THE BID, AGAINST 0.28 AN HOUR AGO. The five-minute bars from 11:20 to 12:15 ET print lows of 34.08, 34.09, 34.14, 34.23, 34.22, 34.19, 34.23, 34.22, 34.14, 34.26, 34.21 and 34.15 - the hour's LOWEST tick is 34.08, a full 0.21 above the limit. So the forty-minute window a resting order would have filled in is closed, and the honest reading is that the entry was available this morning and is not available now. IT IS STILL NOT RAISED. This is the seventh direction the same refusal has been tested in and the most tempting one yet, because the name is drifting away rather than sitting on the level. BOTH INVALIDATIONS WRITTEN BEFORE THE OUTCOME REMAIN UNTRIGGERED. The early warning is a trade below 33.70; that is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening five minutes and untouched since. The outright void is a close below 33.41, now 0.82 below the bid. AS also sits 0.24 UNDER its own 34.47 session high, so this is a name grinding inside its opening range rather than one running away. An hourly reading this at 13:17 needs only the tape, those two numbers, and the 15:30 expiry - three hours and seven minutes of which remained when this row was written.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED, AND THE KILL TEST IS ARGUED AGAINST THE HARDEST VERSION OF ITSELF RATHER THAN THE EASIEST. Limb one, the invalidation, is untriggered and 0.82 from the void. Limb two, the limit no longer inside the spread, is met on a literal reading and rejected on the same narrow one the 10:21 and 11:22 runs wrote down: a buy limit the tape has risen ABOVE is a resting bid, not a dead level, and this morning proved that reading by filling-distance when the name came back through it for forty minutes. LIMB THREE IS WHERE THIS HOUR IS GENUINELY WEAKER THAN THE LAST TWO AND IT IS NOT DRESSED UP. The distance from limit to bid has widened every hour - 0.26 through at 10:23, 0.28 at 11:23, 0.36 now - and a limit that the tape leaves further behind each hour is a limit converging on irrelevance. What stops that becoming a kill is that irrelevance is not invalidation: the specification's own written test is a break of 33.70 or a close under 33.41, neither of which is close, and killing a spec because the price went UP is the mirror image of raising it because the price went up. Both are the tape rewriting a level struck in advance. SO THE ONLY TWO HONEST OUTCOMES ARE HOLD AT 33.87 OR NOTHING, AND NOTHING IS WORSE. A pullback of 1.1% into the limit is an ordinary intraday move in a name whose session range is already 2.3% wide, and the day-2 continuation thesis - a higher low at 33.70 holding on a 100% EPS beat - is intact on every number pulled this hour. THE UNCOMFORTABLE HALF IS UNCHANGED AND IS REPEATED RATHER THAN QUIETLY DROPPED. This is the fifth consecutive published specification nobody executed, and the first whose level printed while it was live and re-validated. Filled at 33.87 it would read 34.23 bid now: 372.57 becoming 376.53, up 3.96 or 1.06%. The 3.96 is not the point. The point is that the board has now spent three hours re-validating an entry it correctly identified, correctly struck, and does not own.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-print gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - ranked second today, refused on item 2, and named in advance as tomorrow's better day-2 candidate if it holds
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 12:23 AND OFF ITS HIGHS AGAIN, WHICH PARTLY UNDOES WHAT THE LAST HOUR WROTE AND THE ROW SAYS SO IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. TGT is 159.95 bid / 160.18 ask at 16:23:32.819Z, last 160.075, +4.90% against the 152.48 close - 0.79 BELOW the 160.74 bid an hour ago and 0.50 below the 160.45 the open refused it at. So across three hourly reads the item-2 refusal has been paid, then regretted, then roughly flat. That sequence is the actual evidence about buying a day-1 high, and it is worth more than any one of the three snapshots. THE WRITTEN TEST FOR TOMORROW IS UNCHANGED: a day-2 hold above today's close on lighter volume, with an entry struck after the fade rather than at the high. Where today's close lands is the input that test needs and it still does not exist.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE STRONGEST THING THIS RUN REFUSED, AND THIS HOUR IS WHAT THAT REFUSAL COSTING LOOKS LIKE. Item 2 refuses buying 9.7% off a session low at a fresh high on day 1; TGT has since made a higher high and the entry that was declined at 160.45 would be green. The rule is not amended for one session, because item 2 is not a prediction that the day-1 high fails - it is a statement that this board does not have an edge buying it, and a rule that survives only while it is winning is not a rule. AS and TGT still differ on exactly one axis, day 2 versus day 1, and holding both visible is what lets the retro grade whether the day-2 preference earns anything or whether it passed on the better trade twice.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, refused for a twelfth time
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON A FIFTEENTH TEST AND NOW WALKING BACK TOWARD THE OLD LIMIT, WHICH STILL CHANGES NOTHING. SMCI is 37.56 bid / 37.57 ask at 16:23:34.100Z, a 0.027% spread and again the tightest quote on the board, +0.40% against the 37.41 close and UP 0.41 from the 37.15 read at 11:23 and 1.10 from the 36.46 read at 10:23. The 37.57 ask is 0.67 below the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 - still a better fill than that order asked for, and still not revived. Had seven shares filled at 38.24 for 267.68 they would read 262.92, -4.76 or -1.78%.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now six sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither is repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/19-to-8/26 calendar re-pulled this run. It keeps its place for liquidity alone, which is still the best here, and it is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 2 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: UP ELEVEN CENTS IN AN HOUR AND STILL NOT A SETUP, WHICH IS THE SAME ANSWER FOR THE SAME REASON. KLAR is 14.82 bid / 14.84 ask at 16:23:34.344Z, -1.59% against the 15.06 close and off the 14.71 read at 11:23. A bounce inside a second consecutive down day is not a base forming. The precondition any entry here would need is a level struck AFTER the gap that holds on lighter volume with a written invalidation, and a one-hour bounce does not supply it. The day-2 argument that confirms AS still does not transfer to a name whose day 1 was -22.5%.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND ON DAY 2 IT IS DOING THAT JOB BETTER THAN IT DID ON DAY 1. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18. AS is +0.6% today after closing +3.2%; KLAR is -2.9% today after closing -22.5%. Two beats, two sessions, opposite outcomes - which is the whole argument for requiring that a catalyst be read together with positioning rather than counted on its own.

candidatesNote: The twelve carried-forward rows are bids from ONE quote call at 13:42:5x UTC and the six names added today are from a second call at 13:43:1x-13:43:2x UTC, so each row is a real timestamped bid rather than a blend. AS and TGT were RE-QUOTED at 13:46:2x when the limit was struck and both numbers are given on those rows. The field was widened rather than the bar lowered: eleven names reported between 8/18 and this morning and all of them are priced here, including the three beats the tape sold, which are the evidence item 5 passed on.

candidates.note: 34.06 bid at 13:42:55Z and RE-QUOTED 33.82 bid / 33.87 ask at 13:46:21Z, +0.60% against the 33.62 close - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares, the second consecutive not-forced entry. Reported 8/18 before the open at 0.22 EPS against 0.11, a 100% beat, verified live. This is the DAY-2 continuation the rulebook names first under setups that fit, and the objection yesterday's open raised against itself - day-1 timing - is spent. Session: opened 33.85, high 34.47, low 33.70; the entry is struck on the 0.24 pullback off the 13:42 read rather than at the high. Liquidity real: 19.71B cap, 5.24M thirty-day average, 452,739 shares in thirteen minutes, 0.148% spread. Its 9/18 32.5 call cleared EVERY option gate at 13:45:01Z on a 1.94% spread with 0.672 delta and 7,857 OI, then quoted 9.71% at 13:46:23Z - refused on that instability, which is why the instrument is equity.

159.44 bid at 13:43:21Z and 160.45 at 13:46:23Z, +5.23% on a 2.46 against 2.25 beat this morning. Opened 148.285 BELOW the 152.48 close and reversed to a 159.94 fifty-two-week high on 2.16M shares against a 4.28M two-week average. RANKED SECOND AND REFUSED ON ITEM 2 - buying here is buying 9.7% off a session low fourteen minutes old, at a new high, on day 1. Named in advance as the better day-2 candidate tomorrow if it holds this close on lighter volume.

97.59 bid, +15.81% on a 0.39 against 0.32 beat. THE +8% DAY item 2 exists to refuse, and by a factor of two. Opened 93.97 and has not traded below it. Not a candidate at any price today; a day-2 or day-3 entry after this digests is the only shape that could ever qualify.

148.73 bid, -1.40% on a 1.22 against 1.19 BEAT. One of three names today that beat and sold off, and part of the live evidence item 5 passed on for AS: crowded expectations mean a merely-good report sells off. Not bought - buying the down half of a print is not a setup here.

373.44 bid, -0.85% on a 3.45 against 3.34 BEAT. Second of today's three sold beats. Also refused mechanically before any view is formed: one share is 37.0% of the account, so a single share is nearly the whole 40% single-name ceiling and there is no room to be wrong about size.
332.36 bid, -2.53% on a 3.07 against 2.42 beat - a 27% beat sold off the next morning, the sharpest of today's three and the cleanest single illustration of item 5 on the board. Not bought.

36.75 bid, -1.76%, and 1.49 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17. Twelfth test, still marketable, still not revived: a lower price does not supply the catalyst item 1 wanted, the 8/11 print is six sessions back, and SMCI is absent from the live 8/19-8/26 calendar. Best liquidity on the board at a 0.05% spread.

14.62 bid, -2.92%, a second consecutive down day after an EPS beat of 0.01 against -0.06. No base has formed, which is the precondition any entry here would need. Kept as the counterexample to today's own thesis: two 8/18 beats, and on day 2 one is +0.6% and the other is -2.9% on top of -22.5%.

160.64 bid, +4.91% on a 1.57 against 1.44 beat after yesterday's close. Ranked third. Refused on the same item 2 ground as TGT: an after-hours print reacting the next morning is effectively day 1, and this is the first session's move.

92.83 bid, +2.16% - bouncing after an 8.66% drop on a 1.06 against 1.35 EPS MISS. A dated catalyst that resolved against the name, and a day-2 bounce off a miss is not the day-2 continuation this rulebook buys. The setup requires the print to have been GOOD.

29.97 bid, +2.95%, back at the 30.20/30.32 shelf whose loss this board wrote as the invalidation in advance - reclaimed from below rather than defended. Eleven sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead, so item 1 refuses it regardless of the level. The expired 30.59 limit stays dead.

76.09 bid, +2.18% on a 2.31 against 2.04 beat this morning. A real beat with a modest reaction, which is the least objectionable of today's fresh prints after TGT. Passed over for AS on the day-1 versus day-2 axis alone, and noted so the ranking is legible.
43.16 bid, -2.18%. Ten sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead and no second argument in the catalyst's place. Item 1 refuses it.
17.25 bid, -2.60%. Nine sessions past its print, nothing dated ahead, and part of the quantum complex that unwound together on 8/17 - the correlation the 2026-08-10 rule was written about.
6.94 bid, -0.72%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. Item 1 refuses it on the same ground as the rest of the carried-forward board.
40.82 bid, -1.31%. Nothing dated ahead. Named in the 8/10 rule as one of the four that led hardest and unwound hardest.
8.65 bid, +0.12%. Nothing dated ahead, and the name this account closed at -14.0% on 8/6. Same complex as OKLO, so two of them would be the concentration limit rather than diversification.

7.58 bid, -0.92%. Nine sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead. The 8.85 limit from the 8/10 forced entry is 16.9% above the bid - dead, and not re-struck cheaper for the same reason SMCI is not.

475.58 bid, -1.82%. One share is 47.1% of the account against the 40% single-name ceiling, so it is refused by an explicit mechanical limit before any view is formed. NVDA reports 8/26, six sessions out, and is the dated event this complex actually turns on.
27.25 bid, -4.35% on a 0.64 against 1.08 EPS MISS, the largest miss on today's calendar. Priced here so the morning's field is recorded whole rather than only its green half. Not a candidate.
